plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history and was billed as a CIA historian, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about a strange moment around 1990. He says he was at Changi Airport in Singapore when a woman he connects with an earlier encounter involving a station wagon appeared again there. He tells it as a sign that something was arranging or watching his path.
